name: Pole of Collapsing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A 10-ft pole that collapses into a 1-ft rod.
text: As a Utilize action, you can shrink this 10-foot pole down to a 1-foot rod that stows easily, and another Utilize action lengthens it again. Its weight stays the same either way. (It does nothing else in the game.)
